text: Government of India Ministry of Tourism (H&R Division) Common National Standards and Guidelines for Classification of Incredible India Bed & Breakfast Establishments and Incredible India Homestay Establishments 1. Hotels and other supplementary accommodation are an integral part of a  tourist's visit to a place and the services o ffered by them can make his/her  visit memorable. With the aim of providing comfortable Bed & Breakfast / Home Stay Facilities of  Standardized World Class Services to the t ourists, and to supplement the  availability of accommodation  across
criteria_type: providing comfortable Bed & Breakfast / Home Stay

text: destinations, Ministry of Tourism will classify fully operational rooms of Home Stay Facilities in States & Union Territories of India where the respective State Government  / UT Administration does not have its own scheme for approval / classification/ accreditation of Bed & Breakfast/ Homestay Establishments, as “Incredible India Bed & Breakfast Establishments” and “Incredible India Homestay Establishments". The  basic idea is to provide a clean and affordable place for foreigners and domestic tourists alike including an opportunity for foreign tourists to stay with an Indian  family to experience Indian customs and traditions and relish authentic Indian customs.

text: The details of the standards, facilities, services and the documents required for approval of such establishments will be as per these guidelines.  These guidelines will supersede the earlier guidelines for approval an d registration of “Incredible India Bed & Breakfast / Homestay Establishments” 4. The Incredible India  Bed & Breakfast  / Homestay Establishments, once approved by Ministry of Tourism, will be duly publicized. A directory of all such approved establishments will also be prepared, so as to enable domestic as well as foreign tourists to live in a homely environment and to take advantage of the scheme. In addition, efforts will be made to organize short term training in hospitality trade to those who would opt for such training.

text: Detailed Guidelines 1. The classification for Incredible India Homestay Establishment will be given only in those cases where the owner  /promoter of the establishment along with his /  her family is physically residing in the same establishment and letting out minimum one room and maximum six rooms (12 beds).
criteria_type: destinations, Ministry of Tourism will classify fu

text: The classification for Incredible India Bed & Breakfast Establishment will be given only in those cases where the owner / promoter of  the establishment  does not reside at the establishment himself/ herself, but an agent or operator, so designated by him/ her resides in the establishment premises for providing the necessary services to the visitors / guests . The establishment would have a minimum of 1 lettable room  and a maximum of 6 lettable rooms (12 beds).

text: 2. The scheme will be on bed and breakfast basis and charges will have to be levied accordingly. The type of breakfast to be offered will have to be specified, the charges will have to be displayed and the visitors will have to be informed in advance so as to avoid unnecessary dispute.
